summary: Tested all 18 Spartan Coaching backend endpoints through the public preview URL. 19/20 pytest tests pass on retry. One real defect: ALL_DRILLS in content.py contains 38 drills instead of the spec'd 40. Two AI endpoints (gpt-4o feedback + long-input) hit transient 'Budget exceeded' errors on first run but passed on immediate retry, indicating a flaky rate/budget throttle on the heavier model rather than broken code.

critical.issue: ALL_DRILLS in content.py only has 38 entries; spec/PRD requires 40. /api/drills/all returns 38 items.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0074, Max budget: 0.001' on first call; succeeds on retry. Appears tied to per-request budget on gpt-4o through emergent LLM key. Wrap llm_complete with a single retry/fallback to gpt-4o-mini, or surface a clearer 503 to the client rather than 500.

Code quality: dead branch `cursor_date = cursor_date.replace(day=cursor_date.day) if False else cursor_date` (server.py line ~349) and `from datetime import timedelta` is imported three separate times inside the function. Functionally correct but should be cleaned up.
llm_complete embeds prior history into the user prompt rather than using LlmChat's native multi-turn session - works but loses model-side memory benefits and inflates token cost.

action_items: Add 2 more drills to ALL_DRILLS in /app/backend/content.py to reach the required 40-drill count (currently 38).

Optional hardening: add a retry-on-budget-error inside llm_complete (or fall back to LLM_MODEL_FAST when LLM_MODEL hits a budget error) so /api/tools/playbook, /api/chat, and /api/roleplay/feedback don't surface 500s during gpt-4o throttling.
Minor cleanup of duplicated `from datetime import timedelta` imports and dead-code branch inside drill_stats().
critical_code_review_comments: Drill count mismatch (38 vs 40) is the only functional defect.
llm_complete: history is concatenated into the prompt; the `if history: for msg in history: ... pass` loop is a no-op left over from refactoring - dead code, remove it.
server.py is 472 lines and currently fits in one module; acceptable, but if more endpoints are added consider splitting into routers (drills, ai, content, contact).
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True - acceptable for a public mobile API but worth noting for security review.
MongoDB _id is never returned (insert_one used only for persistence, responses build their own dicts) - good.
All endpoints under /api prefix and use Pydantic validation - good.
Resend send is synchronous (blocking) inside an async endpoint - may want to wrap in run_in_threadpool to avoid blocking the event loop, though it works fine in practice.

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 tests pass on retry; only blocking issue is the 38-vs-40 drill count assertion)

test_credentials: none required - all endpoints are public
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_<uuid> device IDs for drill streak tests; no cleanup needed (isolated per-device).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_spartan_backend.py after main agent adds 2 drills to ALL_DRILLS. Note that gpt-4o calls (playbook, feedback, chat) occasionally return 500 'Budget exceeded' on first call but succeed on retry - if you see this, run the failing AI test individually a second time to confirm it's the transient throttle and not a true regression. Resend email sending is confirmed working (email_sent:true in /api/contact response).
rca of the issue: Drill count: ALL_DRILLS list in /app/backend/content.py is literally 38 items long; the implementation is correct but the data is short of the 40 specified in the problem statement. Fix is to append 2 more drill dicts (likely Compliance / Mindset categories). Budget error: emergent LLM gateway enforces a per-call max budget; gpt-4o's cost (~$0.007) exceeds the 0.001 cap on some calls and returns BadRequest. The backend currently surfaces this as a raw 500 with the litellm error message - acceptable but not ideal. Reproduces ~10-20% of the time on /api/tools/playbook and /api/roleplay/feedback; retry resolves.
